repository.devCommentItemType: item type determines if the item is a: weapon (1), garment (2) or armour (3). Equipment slot is used to determine what sloth the item will use when equipmed: right hand(1), left hand (2), head (4), body (8), body armour (16). two handed weapons use 3 (1+2)
repository.devCommentEquipEffectors: Equip effectors are everlasting effectors that are active while the item is equipped. example is making a settler slower when an armour is equipped etc. On hit and on Critical hit effectors are effectors that are inflicted to the target. the threshold determines how likely one of these effectors (wounds) will be inflicted to the target. here you can add effects that make the target bleed, or slowly lose speed, or slowly loose HP as a poison effect

primaryWeaponMode.devCommentWeaponType: Weapon type: None = 0,TwoHandBow = 1,TwoHandCrossbow = 2, OneHandMace = 3,TwoHandMace = 4,TwoHandStaff = 5,TwoHandSpear = 6 OneHandAxe = 7, TwoHandAxe = 8,OneHandSword = 9,TwoHandSword = 10,TwoHandRam = 11,Trap = 12. will determine animation among other things. see weaponTypeSettings.json for more info. carryHand can be 1 or 2. 1 is the right hand, 2 is the left one. determines what hand is the main hand for the animation
